difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a flat morphism of schemes which is locally of finite presentation and whose fibres are disjoint unions of spectra of finite separable field extensions is etale. The author notes that this can be deduced from the algebraic characterisation of etale maps and then gives a second, geometric proof: the fibres are etale hence smooth over the residue fields, so the morphism is smooth by the fibrewise smoothness criterion, is unramified by the corresponding criterion for fibres which are disjoint unions of fields, and is therefore etale by the structure of smooth unramified morphisms.
